description.value: FeatureOps platform enterprises use to control how software behaves in production. Described as the largest open source feature flagging solution built for enterprises.
Feature management company based in Oslo, Norway. Its tools let developers implement changes and roll them back if necessary, supporting canary releases.

product_description.value: Open-source feature flagging that can be self-hosted, plus Enterprise Edge for sub-50ms flag evaluation across 35+ regions, managed or self-hosted.

business_model_description.value: Open Source edition is free to self-host. The pay-as-you-go plan starts at $75 per seat per month with a 14-day free trial. Enterprise plans offer custom annual pricing.

customer_description.value: Enterprises at the world's largest organisations, across banking and insurance, retail, payments and enterprise technology.
